title: stranvaesia oblanceolata

This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial actions. The therapeutic actions of Stranvaesia oblanceolata are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, that have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, thereby providing relief from various health issues.
